reviewer: assistant visual spectral interpretation, not a human usability trial
review_basis: Full 600-second overview and all five 120-second pages, then audio-only magnification; no detector overlay, aircraft identity, fitted trajectory or exact receiver coordinate consulted

event.interpretation: Sustained roughly 150 Hz tonal ridge; possible moving source, aircraft identity unconfirmed
event.related_harmonics: Roughly 75 and 225 Hz bands are related-source possibilities, not additional independent evidence
event.selection: Explicit experiment-only eligibility; pending operator annotation remains unconfirmed

rejections.reason: Several short or overlapping contours; no separately selected sustained identifiable source
Rapid rising/falling tonal fragments and source overlap; not selected as a constant-tone aircraft event
Strong overlapping steep contours make continuation of the chosen ridge ambiguous
Repeated large pitch rises/drops inconsistent with assuming a single constant emitted tone without additional evidence
Brief dense harmonic sweeps and other short fragments; no second independent source selected

search.grid_method: Inclusive rectangular endpoints; 111320 metres per degree and cosine of midpoint latitude; no truth-centered receiver
search.source_approval: Every geometrically imported native pass whose original timestamp support overlaps the event plus declared clock range and a 600-second acoustic look-back; no fit, distance-to-truth or aircraft-type selection
search.source_pass_grouping: None in primary experiment; if native limits are exceeded, preserve the blocked request and document any subsequent experiment separately
search.refinement: No refinement before this frozen broad result is recorded

evaluation.location_acceptance: None based on this single unidentified tone. Error and shortlist recall are descriptive field evidence; no calibrated confidence or acoustic-source identification claimed
evaluation.known_limits: One deployment and one selected tone; unknown absolute recorder-clock and publisher-marker errors; sampled aircraft index may omit the real source; no lightning data or hybrid accuracy claim
